notes: Nine representative costume/persona interpretations; not a complete costume inventory. Dates denote associated drama debut year, not every costume component's first use. Classic looks undated. Reference images are used for identity and costume only.
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept / reference-guided character illustration.
Create a finished 2D character design comparison plate of 秦假仙 (Qin Jia Xian) from Taiwan's PILI glove puppet dramas, faithfully translating the supplied puppet-photo references into Hong Kong/Taiwan wuxia comic character art.
Style: expressive hand-inked variable-width black contours, confident dramatic HK wuxia comic drawing, crisp Taiwanese animation character-design cel colors, selective restrained cross-hatching and painted fabric shading. It MUST look hand-drawn 2D, not a photograph, 3D render, realistic doll, generic anime pretty boys, chibi, or Western superhero. Keep each reference's face identity, hairstyle, headwear, color blocking and iconic costume details. For clown-like ordinary Qin forms preserve the broad expressive face, angular eyebrows and distinctive small red flattened nose area; do not replace it with a spherical Western clown nose. Special disguises have their own reference faces/masks; do not homogenize them.
Layout: high-resolution landscape character lineup, three equally wide columns, exactly THREE full-body figures with complete headpieces and feet visible, generous separation, same floor level, no overlapping silhouettes. Each figure about 5.5 heads tall, slightly theatrical compact silhouette while elegant robe shapes remain readable. Plain warm ivory paper backdrop, only extremely faint ink wash below feet, no scenery, no frames, no official logos, no source-watermarks, no extra characters. Quiet dark calligraphic Chinese title at top, small tidy Traditional Chinese nameplate under each figure, typesetting must be legible. No extra paragraphs.
Render the puppet photos as polished drawn humans/characters while respecting the unusual designs; the supplied photos are identity/costume references, not images to collage. Where feet/lower hems are absent from photos, create conservative matching robe hems and cloth shoes rather than new armor or fantasy props. This is an artistic interpretation, not an official chronological archival plate.
Plate 1, title exactly:「秦假仙・經典與千禧扮相」.
Reference image 1 ONLY determines LEFT figure, label「經典本相」: old classic Qin, black hair pulled into small topknot with tiny colored feather crest, two thin side braids, yellowish broad expressive comic face with large arched eyes and toothy cheeky grin, red flattened triangular nose, dark muted olive/teal patterned long outer robe, pale warm beige ruffled scarf/cravat, muted green striped front apron panel and maroon trousers; pose one hand touching his hair, other palm forward, corresponding closely to photo.
Reference image 2 ONLY determines CENTER figure, label「許願仙｜2000」: bizarre wish-vendor clown disguise, very tall ivory multi-point floppy jester hat with dark royal blue band and yellow ornamental motifs and red pom-poms, white face with original blue/green eye paint and red nose, elongated pale beard-like fabric under chin, dark blue/white patterned layered costume with red gingham sleeve accents and bright red/yellow trim. Retain the small yellow/red wand visible in photo. The headgear silhouette is central to this form; keep its shapes.
Reference image 3 ONLY determines RIGHT figure, label「藍俠一枝花｜2002」: long straight deep crimson/red hair parted center, dark navy cutout dotted half-face mask across nose/mouth, a single black eyepatch over one eye, light icy blue/silver embellished wuxia layered robes and bead ornaments, carries a single rose near her face as in reference, sword pouch discreetly on back. This is a feminine transformation/disguise, dignified cheeky theatrical confidence, not sexualized. Preserve the actual masked visual; no uncovered generic Qin face.

Plate 2, title exactly:「秦假仙・中期造型」.
Reference image 1 ONLY determines LEFT figure, label「超級先行人｜2005」: bald pink domed head, round small gold-rim spectacles hanging low, long narrow tall black cone hat perched at the very top, small long dark side hair tufts, puckered eccentric mouth, white broad high collar with black/gold edging and rich red/gold center robe panels. Whimsical slightly stooped stance, true to reference rather than ordinary Qin face.
Reference image 2 ONLY determines CENTER figure, label「風流齋主｜2011」: long black hair with high rising elaborate swept black topknot and small purple/silver jeweled hairpin, FULL smooth pale silver mask covering the entire face with tiny decorative forehead crest; calm elegant eyes visible in mask openings; flowing clean ivory-white Taoist robes with subtle lavender grey embroidery and black hair over shoulders; holds a restrained white horsehair whisk low to side. This disguise is tall slim, elegant, mysterious, face must stay fully masked.
Reference image 3 ONLY determines RIGHT figure, label「黑白常服」: ordinary Qin recognizable broad face, raised arched dark eyebrows, enormous lively eyes, small red flattened nose, long crisp black curled handlebar moustache, short blunt black bangs, black bob sides and high topknot pierced by red ornamental stick, red forehead circlet with central dark red round jewel. Layered white wide-sleeve robe beneath black outer vest/robe embroidered with thin silver irregular square grid, red edge piping, large antique-gold ring clasps on shoulders and front, long white/red waist tassels. Gesture raised palm and sly self-assured expression close to photo. Do not label this form with a fabricated date.
Reference image 4 is the already-finished companion plate: use ONLY its 2D ink line style, warm paper background, color rendering, full-body scale, top-title and bottom-nameplate layout for visual consistency. Do not reuse any of its characters or costumes.

Plate 3, title exactly:「秦假仙・後期與重製版」.
Reference image 1 ONLY determines LEFT figure, label「天下第三人｜2016」: light chestnut/honey brown voluminous swept hair and long flowing brown side locks, ornate gold crown with red gem, distinctive Qin large eyes, small red flattened nose and neat brown curled moustache; exuberant confident expression, white/ivory high-collared layered robes heavily edged in gold floral brocade, rounded sculptural shoulder mantle, restrained red gem ornaments. Preserve this comedic pseudo-immortal silhouette rather than an anonymous handsome sage.
Reference image 2 ONLY determines CENTER figure, label「情公子｜2018」: disguised youthful elegant gentleman, refined pale face, no moustache, long black hair with curled side fringe and small white/silver ornamental scholar crown, fine silver/white layered robe with pale blue dark-blue silver embroidered borders, navy shoulder accents, understated small red lip, reserved confident glance. This form deliberately has a handsome disguise; preserve that photo likeness rather than forcing ordinary Qin's red nose/moustache onto him.
Reference image 3 ONLY determines RIGHT figure, label「刀說異數版｜2019」: tall fluffy off-white/light-blond fur hat with three conspicuous gold beads, light tan side hair, distinctively wide round black-outlined eyes, short upward curved dark moustache, broad distinctive face with low small reddish nose, patchwork blue-violet and deep indigo robe with ornate gold trim and warm ivory/gold broad collar. Hands slightly gesturing as if talking fast. Keep the fur headgear fluffy and silhouette recognizable, not a jeweled metal helmet.
